name: Helideck lighting and deck markings
description: Perimeter and flood lighting, the status light, the D-value circle, touchdown/aiming circle and obstacle-free-sector markings. All are defined by the helideck standard for the helicopter the deck is rated for.

gaps.what: Lighting levels, D-value and marking dimensions
gaps.why: No page read gives the lighting levels, D-value or marking dimensions for a rated helicopter.
gaps.next_action: Fetch CAP 437 and record lighting levels, D-value and marking dimensions

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
